condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

description.narrative: 1.1 Existence of the relevant legal and regulatory framework that is complaint with sukuk, "green" bonds, Shariah Governance framework and green principles 1.2 Existence of the National Green Sukuk Framework that provides a foundation for the issuance of sovereign and corporate sukuks and green sukuks 1.3 Number of awareness rising campaigns on Green sukuk targeting public, investors, government bodies and other stakeholders 1.5 Number of capacity building activities and workshops on Islamic finance conducted for various stakeholders

comment.narrative: Lack of relevant legal and regulatory framework that is complaint with sukuk, "green" bonds, Shariah Governance framework and green principles

1. A Concept Note aimed at ensuring that legislation and taxation in Uzbekistan provide equal treatment of Sukuks with conventional bonds from issuer and investor perspectives developed and submitted to the Government for approval. 2. A full package of draft legal and regulatory documents for introduction of Plain Vanilla and Green Sukuks in Uzbekistan developed. 3. National Green Sukuk framework that provides a foundation for the issuance of sovereign and corporate sukuks in Uzbekistan developed. 4. An awareness rising campaign on Green sukuk targeting public, investors, government bodies and other stakeholders conducted. 5. A workshop on Islamic finance and green sukuk conducted for various stakeholders

1. A Concept paper for development of legal framework for Sukuk and Green Sukuk in Uzbekistan has been developed, presented, and discussed with the stakeholders (55 participants including 40 male and 15 female) during the Workshop held on 30 June 2022.
Ozbekiston Respublikasi Moliya Vazirligi - O?zbekiston Respublikasida “Sukuk” va “Yashil Sukuk” uchun huquqiy-me'yoriy bazani ishlab chiqish bo?yicha vebinar (mf.uz)
2. An International (White & Case) and local (Azizov & Partners) law companies have drafted the legal and regulatory documents including relevant amendments to the existing ones for introduction of Sukuk and Green Sukuks in Uzbekistan. The draft legal/regulatory documents have been submitted to the Uzbek Ministry of Finance and currently is under review by the national partner. It is expected that the Ministry of Finance will facilitate further discussion of the draft legal/regulatory documents with the relevant ministries and government agencies.
3. Due to the request of the national partner the planned activity on development of the National Green Sukuk framework has been postponed to the next year.
4. A webinar titled “Sukuk Bonds as a Promising Alternative Financing Source for Uzbeks Issuers and investors” has been conducted on 25 March 2022 jointly by UNDP, the Ministry of Finance, Islamic Corporation for the Development of the Private Sector (ICD), and Ansher Capital LLC with participation of more than 60 participants (40 male and 20 female) representing the government, investors, private sector, public, international partners, etc. The event served as a convenient platform for discussing the ongoing reforms and activities related to the introduction of Islamic finance instruments including the green sukuk in Uzbekistan.
